g.text: Possible misuse of hexadecimal literal notation. This literal is interpretted as an Integer value of -32768 (&HFFFF8000). The value is also being converted to a wider type, and so this is likely a mistake. Use &H8000& to force the literal into the correct type and prevent unwanted side-effects.
